'''Ulaaar''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and leader of the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He fought against the [[Garrison/Legends|Imperial garrison]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] together with his fellow [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[warrior]]s.
